group.passage: The yeti crab is a fascinating deep-sea creature that lives in the depths of the ocean. The yeti crab has a distinctive appearance that sets it apart from other creatures. Its most striking feature is the dense and thick covering of hair-like bristles on its body, which is an oval-shaped exoskeleton that is pale or whitish in color. The crab’s large and hairy claws help it capture tiny organisms and particles from the water. Its legs, in comparison, are believed to have shrunk greatly through evolution. Also, it has small eyes on long and thin stalks to sense its challenging environment with extremely high pressure, darkness, and high temperatures. Yeti crabs play a crucial role in the deep-sea ecosystem. Unlike large marine animals like sharks and whales, yeti crabs are primary scavengers, relying on their claws to comb through the ocean floor in search of scraps and decaying organic matter. By consuming and recycling the remains of dead animals or plants, yeti crabs help prevent the spread of diseases and clean up the environment. Furthermore, a yeti crab also serves as a host for special bacteria among its hairy bristles, forming a symbiotic relationship. That is, these bacteria derive energy and nutrients from chemical compounds in the crab’s habitats, while the crab benefits from the organic molecules produced by the bacteria. Despite its remarkable adaptations, the yeti crab faces several threats in its deep-sea habitat. One significant issue has to do with deep-sea mining activities. With increasing interest in mining for minerals and resources in the deep sea, the delicate ecosystems where yeti crabs reside are at risk of destruction and disturbance. Climate change also poses a threat. The yeti crab’s reliance on specific conditions makes it especially vulnerable to any disruptions in these ecosystems. Currently, efforts are underway to conserve the threatened yeti crabs, including closer monitoring and implementing sustainable fishing practices. Time will tell whether those efforts will pay off in the long run.

figures.label: 第1題選項 (A)–(D)
figures.description: 第1題的四個選項都是黑白寫實線描圖，各畫一種甲殼類／節肢動物，沒有文字說明；(A)–(C) 是由上往下看的背面圖，(D) 是腹面圖。(A) 外形像蹲龍蝦：一對非常長、向前伸出的螯肢上布滿濃密的毛狀剛毛，身體（背甲）為淺色、橢圓形，表面也覆有細毛，頭部伸出兩根細長的觸角，其餘步足短小並長有剛毛，整隻顏色偏白。(B) 一隻典型的螃蟹：寬而圓的背甲顏色較深，一對螯和數對步足向兩側張開，腳上有少許細毛。(C) 一隻像帝王蟹／蜘蛛蟹的螃蟹：小而圓、布滿疣狀凸起和短刺的背甲，數對細長且多刺的長腳向四周伸展，螯很小。(D) 一隻鱟（馬蹄蟹），從腹面看：圓弧形、馬蹄狀的硬殼，殼緣有刺，尾端有一根又長又尖、直立的尾劍，腹面可見數對小腳。

questions.stem: Which of the following pictures is most likely a yeti crab?

options.A: ［圖］一隻外形像蹲龍蝦的甲殼動物：一對很長、向前伸出、布滿濃密毛狀剛毛的螯；淺色橢圓形的身體（背甲）覆有細毛；頭部有兩根細長觸角；步足短小、長有剛毛。
options.B: ［圖］一隻典型的螃蟹：寬圓、顏色較深的背甲，一對螯與數對步足向兩側張開，腳上有少許細毛。
options.C: ［圖］一隻像帝王蟹／蜘蛛蟹的螃蟹：小而圓、布滿疣狀凸起與短刺的背甲，數對細長多刺的長腳向四周伸展，螯很小。
options.D: ［圖］一隻鱟（馬蹄蟹）的腹面：圓弧形馬蹄狀硬殼、殼緣有刺，尾端有一根長而尖的尾劍，腹面有數對小腳。

options.C: Animals are dying fast because of a lack of food in their natural habitats.
